stem: Which sentence from the selection supports the idea that Christmas Island is a special place?

options.label: A
options.text: The red land crab makes up the largest population of the land crab species.

options.label: B
options.text: The island boasts an array of exotic plants and animals, some of which are found nowhere else in the world.

options.label: C
options.text: Only 1,500 or so people lived on the island as of 2010.

options.label: D
options.text: Christmas Island is an Australian territory in the Indian Ocean.
